mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET route = #{route} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS total_runs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_runs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'FAILED') AS failed_runs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_call_log log JOIN agent_run ar ON ar.id = log.agent_run_id WHERE ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AS total_tool_calls, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tool_call_log log JOIN agent_run ar ON ar.id = log.agent_run_id WHERE ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND log.success = TRUE) AS successful_tool_calls, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(log.duration_ms) FROM tool_call_log log JOIN agent_run ar ON ar.id = log.agent_run_id WHERE ar.tenant_id = #{tenantId}), 0) AS average_tool_duration_ms
